# RULES.md — Redirected (v3.0)

As of v3.0 (2026-04-25), this file has been split into a layered architecture:

| File | Scope |
|------|-------|
| **[RULES-CORE.md](RULES-CORE.md)** | Universal translation governance (source-language-agnostic) |
| **[RULES-HB.md](RULES-HB.md)** | Hebrew Bible supplement (Hebrew + Aramaic) |
| **[RULES-GS.md](RULES-GS.md)** | Greek Scriptures supplement (Koine Greek) |

**All three files together** constitute the complete governance system.

Historical references to "RULES.md" in editorial log entries and audit documents
refer to the pre-v3.0 unified file and remain valid as historical records.

**Post-v3.0 citation convention:**
- Universal rules: "CORE Rule N"
- Hebrew-specific: "HB §Section Name"
- Greek-specific: "GS §Section Name"
